strategy: Revert the single P0-T01D Platform Contracts commit after human review.
steps: Identify the merged P0-T01D commit in asxeed-codex/asxeed-platform-contracts.
Create a dedicated rollback branch from the then-current protected base.
Use git revert on only the P0-T01D commit; do not reset, rewrite, or delete predecessor history.
Run the existing Platform Contracts verifier, JSON parsing, Markdown link checks, and git diff --check.
Obtain human review before merging the rollback.
preserves: all canonical Architecture Freeze, ADR, Technology Baseline, Master Plan, Task Graph, and Sprint Plan files
